title: fix(dispatch-gates): a package-root vitest config or manifest edit derives check-console-intercept-disarm
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ87YEMjdviwYR817rnQYfmc8)_

Fixes #29353

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`check-console-intercept-disarm` 在自己源码里声明它真正读的文件(各工作区包根的 `package.json` 与 `vitest.config.*`),`dispatch-gates` 据此把它派给改这些文件的卡;残差台账里它的两行随之删除。
- 为什么改:改包根 vitest 配置的卡,本地派生清单里没有这道门,只能等 CI 变红才知道(PR #29345 为此多跑了一轮)。
- 风险与回滚:只动工具脚本,不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR,派生回到原先的"无路径"状态。
- 先看:`scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs`(新声明与漂移检查)、`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`(新增的实树钉子)、`scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`(删掉的两行)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --paths packages/services/service-sms/vitest.config.ts`,预期输出里出现这道门的两条命令(主扫描与 `--self-test`)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **Landing is the gate's own file, not only `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`.** The order expected the data table; measured, the derivation reads a gate's population only from the gate's own source (the `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS` idiom), and `dispatch-gates.data.mjs`'s header says it is "not a watch surface". So the producer-side fix is a declaration in `scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs`:
  - `ROOT_DIR_WATCH_HINTS`: one pair per workspace glob the gate parses, `DIR/*/package.json` and `DIR/*/vitest.config.*`. A glob in a non-final segment makes the derivation judge the hint as a pattern, one path segment per star, so a test file or a config below the package root is not covered.
  - A drift check: `main()` exits 1 when the declaration and the parsed `pnpm-workspace.yaml` globs disagree in either direction (`watchHintDrift`), and the gate's self-test holds the real tree to it plus both drift directions on fixtures. A literal array, as `check:watch-hint-literal` requires.
  - `workspaceGlobs()` is split out of `workspacePackageDirs()` with no change in behaviour; the three gates that import `workspacePackageDirs` are untouched.
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.data.mjs`: the two `ROOT_WALK_RESIDUE_LEDGER` rows for the gate and its `--self-test` are retired, since both families have left the population. A note records why, beside the two earlier departures.
- `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.self-test.mjs`: the card's acceptance, pinned against the live tree. Every package-root vitest config (80) and the manifest beside it places both invocations. A new package's config and manifest do too. No tracked test file under a package (6926) places either, and neither does a brand-new test file or a config below a package root.

## Why

The rows stated the population correctly and drew the wrong conclusion: an EDITED package-root config moves the gate as surely as a new package does. Because the rows only exempted the gate from the whole-tree channel, no path derived it at all.

## Tests

- Reverse check, with the gate file restored to `399df5bb` (tree only, then restored from HEAD; `git diff HEAD` empty, blob hash matched): 80 of 80 package-root configs place neither invocation, and the test-file probe reads `undetermined`. With the fix, 0 of 80 are missed, and test files read `silent`.
- `node scripts/check-console-intercept-disarm.mjs --self-test`: `self-test OK: 15 cases + real-tree population floor + watch-hint declaration.` Scan: `OK: 80 vitest-running package(s)`.

## Verification

Final union on head `1b3ea66a` (base `399df5bb`): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 32 commands from the 3 changed paths; all 32 exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: "32 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 32 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". `check:pm-dispatch-gates`: "1945 cases pass" (fast tier). The first pass on `a39185ba` was 31 of 32: `check:watch-hint-literal` refused the `Object.freeze` wrapper, fixed in `1b3ea66a`.

## Acceptance notes

- Not derivable, by construction: `pnpm-workspace.yaml` and the root `vitest.preset.mts` also move this gate, but neither carries a separator, so no spelling of either is a hint the derivation admits. Edits to those two files still learn of the gate from CI.
- Out of scope, reported to the seat and not fixed here: the gate's workspace parse stops at the first comment line inside the `packages:` list, so the four `ui` members below it are outside its population. Measured: 40 `ui` workspace packages run vitest and none sets the disarm. The declaration follows what the gate reads today, and its drift check will ask for the `ui` pairs on the day the parse reads them.

- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI-owned run)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset. (publishes nothing: `scripts/**` only, `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
